//: finance and stickers reference their assets relatively, so a page served at /finance would resolve them against / and 404 every one. Landing on the trailing slash is what makes relative paths resolve inside the prefix. terminal needs no such redirect: its paths are root-absolute and are matched explicitly below.

rewrites.//: terminal's own page routes are root-absolute, so without these the catch-all sends them to the apex and every in-app link 404s -- Next prefetches them on load, which is how it was caught. This list has to track app/**/page.tsx by hand; giving terminal a basePath at cutover is what makes it self-maintaining.
terminal's root-absolute assets. maps also serves /_next and so cannot be routed until one of the two takes a basePath -- see the cutover phase in docs/SAME-ORIGIN-TRANSITIONS.md.
